body:
The field of software testing is constantly evolving, and keeping up to date is essential for professionals wishing to remain competitive.

As of May 2024, the ISTQB® Certified Tester Foundation Level certification exam is now based solely on ISTQB Foundation 4.0, for both the English and French versions . Previous versions, such as 3.1, have been completely retired.

This major update reflects the evolution of practices and technologies in the field, with an increased focus on modern methods such as Agile testing, test automation and risk management.

In this article, we’ll explore the main new features of this version and their importance for software testers.

1- What’s new in the ISTQB Foundation 4.0 Syllabus?

The ISTQB Foundation 4.0 syllabus has been completely revised to better reflect modern software development and testing methods. It introduces important new features such as risk-based testing, exploratory testing and performance testing. The revised structure is aligned with current learning objectives and places particular emphasis on agile methods, highlighting the importance of testing in flexible environments.

In addition, the syllabus improves coverage of basic concepts, clarifies testing processes, levels and types with more practical examples and scenarios, and integrates modern concepts such as continuous testing and test-driven development (TDD) to meet current market needs and prepare testers for contemporary challenges.

2. Why is this update to the ISTQB Foundation 4.0 Syllabus important?

There are several reasons why this update to ISTQB Foundation V4.0 is essential:

  • Up-to-date knowledge: ISTQB Foundation version 4.0 is aligned with the latest industry practices and technologies, ensuring that candidates are up to date with the latest trends in software testing. This enables professionals to stay at the cutting edge of innovations and methodologies.
  • Comprehensive understanding: covering topics as diverse as test design techniques, test management and tool usage, V4.0 offers a complete overview of software testing. This holistic approach enables testers to navigate efficiently through various test scenarios.
  • Focus on practice: rather than concentrating solely on theory, ISTQB Foundation 4.0 emphasizes the practical application of concepts in real-life situations. Candidates must demonstrate their ability to use the knowledge they have acquired to solve real-life problems, reinforcing their experience and problem-solving skills.
  • Global standardization: ISTQB Foundation 4.0, in line with recognized ISTQB® standards, ensures consistent software testing practices worldwide. This creates a common language and shared framework among testers, fostering better communication and collaboration within international teams.
  • Career development: As a widely recognized basic qualification, ISTQB Foundation 4.0 enhances the credibility and visibility of testers on the job market. This certification opens doors to new career opportunities by demonstrating a commitment to professional growth and quality testing. Employers value this certification because it attests to a solid understanding of testing principles and methodologies.
3- The strength of ISTQB Foundation certification with international recognition

One of the major strengths of ISTQB Foundation 4.0 certification is its worldwide recognition. The syllabus covers a wide range of software testing topics, ensuring that graduates have a thorough understanding of all aspects of testing. Thanks to standardized examination practices, individuals are assessed according to the same criteria, regardless of their location, making certification reliable and consistent. This gives candidates a competitive edge on the job market, particularly in large international technology companies.

By adopting ISTQB Foundation 4.0 , you’ll be ready to master modern software testing practices and meet today’s industry challenges.
